title: Homology of abelian-group complexes preserves directed colimits
statement: Let I be a small directed preorder, possibly empty [def-weil-pbc-category-colimit]. Let c be any complex shape on ℤ × ℤ and let pq be a bidegree. In the abelian category of abelian groups [def-sp-abelian], let H_pq denote the homology functor from complexes of shape c to abelian groups: the kernel of the outgoing differential modulo the image of the incoming differential. Then H_pq preserves colimits of diagrams indexed by I, with the comparison induced by the homology maps of the colimit cocone legs. No looplessness or convergence assumption on c is required.

source.place: Tag 00DB (lemma-directed-colimit-exact), homology comparison; specialization to abelian groups and adjacent terms of homological complexes

proof.text: If I is nonempty it is filtered. For a diagram F of short complexes, form the short complex S of I-diagrams via ShortComplex.functorEquivalence.inverse. Evaluation preserves homology. The inverse evaluation homology isomorphisms assemble into H(S) ≅ F ⋙ H: homologyMap_mapNatTrans for the evaluation natural transformations proves their naturality.

The colimit functor on abelian-group diagrams preserves homology by directed-colimit exactness. Compose its inverse homology isomorphism with the colimit of the diagram isomorphism from the preceding step. This gives colim(F ⋙ H) ≅ H(colim F). Applying homologyMap_mapNatTrans to the natural transformation evaluation_i → colim identifies the legs of this isomorphism with the homology maps of the standard short-complex colimit cocone. Transporting the colimit universal property along this cocone isomorphism proves preservation.

The shortComplexFunctor of a homological complex preserves I-colimits: each of its three projections is an evaluation, and evaluations preserve colimits. ShortComplex.isColimitOfIsColimitπ supplies the universal property. Compose with the preceding preservation theorem and transport along HomologicalComplex.homologyFunctorIso.

If I is empty, homology preserves zero morphisms, hence zero and initial objects. It therefore preserves colimits of the empty diagram. The equivalence between I and Discrete PEmpty transports this preservation to the original indexing category.
